description:
Your playlists, beautifully organised. NovaStream is a fast, elegant player for the IPTV playlists you already have.

NovaStream does not include any channels, movies or series. Add a playlist from your own provider, an M3U link or an Xtream Codes login, and NovaStream turns it into a clean TV and media library.

LIVE TV WITH A REAL GUIDE
Browse channels by category, see what is on now and next with the EPG, and jump straight in. Mark favourites so the channels you watch most are always one tap away.

MOVIES AND SERIES
Your provider's movies and series appear as a poster library with seasons, episodes and plots. Pick up where you left off with Continue Watching, and move to the next episode automatically.

A PLAYER THAT FEELS NATIVE
Native iOS playback controls with AirPlay and Picture in Picture, so you can keep watching while you do something else.

MULTIPLE PLAYLISTS
Keep several playlists side by side and switch between them in a moment. Lock chosen categories with a 4-digit PIN.

NETWORK TOOLS
A built-in speed test and DNS diagnostics help you understand slow or failing streams.

Available in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Romanian and Turkish.

Try every feature free for 7 days. After that, NovaStream Pro is an auto-renewable yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

NovaStream is a media player only. Use it only with content you have the right to access.

Terms of Use: https://www.novastreamapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.novastreamapp.com/privacy
License agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
promotionalText: Turn your own IPTV playlist into a beautiful TV guide and media library. Live TV with EPG, movies, series and Picture in Picture.
